parsed.rationale: All three types — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each independently defines an identical `displayName` computed property at exactly line 41 of their respective files. Because the implementations are exact duplicates (query: `function-duplicates-exact`) and all context flags are false, there is no restraint marker preventing consolidation. The idiomatic Swift solution is to introduce a protocol `BlendModeDisplayable` with a default implementation of `displayName` in a protocol extension, likely constrained to `RawRepresentable where RawValue == String` given the naming pattern of blend-mode enums, so all three conformers inherit the implementation without any per-type boilerplate.
